title: Diffusion Studio for Windows
summary: Diffusion Studio for Windows is available. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or Gemini CLI and edit video on your PC.
body_markdown:
Diffusion Studio is now available for Windows.


Create and edit your videos with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other supported agents. Ask your agent to create a video from a brief or continue a project you’ve already started.


Your projects save locally, with code as the source of truth. Your agent can edit what you create, and you can edit what it creates. You can also use Git to track changes and collaborate with your team.


To get started, install the Windows app and connect your preferred agents in Settings under MCP & CLI.


[Download Diffusion Studio for Windows](https://get.microsoft.com/installer/download/XP9CW1WHRX3693) .
